targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: SD-034 / MECH-260 (460c): non_contributory, substrate_ceiling, pending_retest_after_substrate. First behavioural arm of SD-034 on the 603n foraging-competent substrate; ClosureOperator done-token never fired (n_closures=0 on 3/3 seeds despite env sequence_completions=2/5/6 and beta elevated) because the env completion signal is not routed into emit_closure() and the automatic rule_state-stability trigger is unmet (untrained/zeroed rule_bias_head + SP-CEM perturbation). MECH-260 No-Go is strictly downstream of a closure event -> nogo_installed=0 confirms the closure->No-Go ordering, not a No-Go failure. Non-vacuity gate checked env-completion-availability, not closure-trigger-availability (V3-EXQ-642 pattern). Not a falsification. Retest after amend.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Wire env sequence_complete -> ClosureOperator.emit_closure() + de-commitment hold; train rule_bias_head in behavioural arm
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Route the env transition_type=='sequence_complete' into ClosureOperator.emit_closure(action_class, z_world) (the explicit env-completion hook the docstring describes), and/or ensure a trained magnitude-bearing lateral-PFC rule_state (GAP-D train_rule_bias_head) so the automatic rule-stability detector can co-satisfy its conjunction; add a de-commitment hold/refractory term so a closure-coupled release survives >1 tick.

failure_record_entry.metric: ARM_CLOSURE_ON n_closures=0 on 3/3 seeds despite n_sequence_completions=2/5/6; nogo_installed_total=0
failure_record_entry.target: n_closures>=1 reachable on the positive control AND nogo_installed>=1 on >=2/3 seeds after env->emit_closure wiring

learning_extracted: SD-034 closure requires the env task-completion event routed into emit_closure() (explicit hook unwired in the *c cohort)
automatic rule_state-stability detector needs a trained magnitude-bearing rule_state (GAP-D) to fire
MECH-260 No-Go zero is a positive-negative confirming the closure->No-Go ordering
readiness precondition must gate on closure-detector-trigger-availability (n_closures>0 reachable), not env-completion-availability

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: SD-034 / MECH-268 / MECH-090 (468c): non_contributory, substrate_ceiling, pending_retest_after_substrate. ON-arm closure-coupled beta releases fire MORE near contradiction (C1 PASS, ON 14/14/69 vs OFF 6/8/20) -- a weak positive that the mechanism is operative -- but C2 (committed_frac_post_vs_pre < 0.85) FAILs because the release lacks a de-commitment hold (the latch re-elevates) and the metric is a near-cap-pinned post/pre ratio (~39, post pinned at the 195-step window). Not evidence that SD-034 closure is wrong; the de-commitment authority + the DV were the gaps. Retest with a hold/refractory term and a non-cap-pinned de-commitment statistic.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: De-commitment hold/refractory term on closure-coupled release
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Add a hold/refractory term so a closure/MECH-268-saturation-coupled beta release survives >1 tick and produces a measurable latch-occupancy drop; the behavioural arm reads de-commitment on a non-cap-pinned statistic (fraction of post-contradiction ticks uncommitted, or committed-run-length delta).

failure_record_entry.metric: C1 beta_release_near_contradiction PASS (ON>OFF) but C2 committed_frac_post_vs_pre ~39 both arms (no de-commitment drop)
failure_record_entry.target: post-contradiction uncommitted-fraction (non-cap-pinned) ON < OFF on >=2/3 seeds after de-commit-hold amend

learning_extracted: closure-coupled release needs a de-commitment hold/refractory term to survive >1 tick
C1 PASS (more release near contradiction under ON) is a weak positive that the closure/saturation coupling is operative
the de-commitment DV must be a non-cap-pinned statistic, not post/pre against a 5-step pre-baseline

cluster_pattern.shape: SD-034 closure control-plane is wired and its proximal events partially fire/are reachable, but on the 603n foraging-competent agent it has no behavioural authority over MECH-090 latch occupancy -- env completion is not routed into the closure trigger (460c n_closures=0) and the closure-coupled release has no de-commitment hold (468c committed_frac cap-pinned)
cluster_pattern.structural_property: the substrate has the closure wiring the claims assert but does not carry the completion->closure->de-commitment information at the granularity the claims assert (substrate_ceiling); convergent with the modulatory-bias-selection-authority theme at the commitment-latch layer rather than the E3-argmin layer
